objection.quote: - Remaining crux: **prove shrinkage stops** (equivalently: finitely many permanents / $S_\infty$ finitely generated).
objection.witness: Missing: a proof, valid for all terms, that membership depends only on primes in a fixed finite set — e.g. that any candidate divisible by a large prime is dominated by a smaller integer with the same small-prime support which is itself a term, hence $S_\infty$ has finitely many minimal elements. The quoted line explicitly labels this as the unproved remaining crux; the surrounding evidence is only empirical ('Empirics (100+ values of $a_1$ ...): shrinkage ALWAYS stops').
objection.load_bearing: Without finiteness of the generating family, $L$ cannot be formed as a product of finitely many primes and no periodicity follows; the text itself identifies this as the missing step.
